title: The Llama 2025 Roadmap: What Meta Actually Signaled
caption:
Meta announced 'Tour de Llama 2025' today. Most headlines will focus on the buzz, but if you squint at the framing, you'll see the single line that changes how you build next year.

This isn't just about bigger models; it's a clear signal on Meta's commitment to the Llama ecosystem as a platform. For builders, this means preparing for a more robust, open-source-aligned toolkit. The unglamorous part? Operationalizing these future capabilities, not just waiting for them. Think about how you'll integrate enhanced fine-tuning or multimodal inputs into your agent workflows now, not next year.

What this does not do is position Llama as a direct, head-on competitor to every closed-source offering. Meta is playing a different game: enabling a decentralized AI stack where you maintain more control. Your move is to leverage that, starting this week, by prototyping with the current Llama releases.

I debrief one of these daily — one email, free, no fluff, just what matters for shipping. BUILD for the field guide.
